note: Single source of truth for camera window geometry. x/y/w/h are pixels on the 1920x1080 broadcast canvas. overlay.js paints the transparent punch-through frames from this file; scripts/obs/setup_obs.py positions the OBS camera sources on the same numbers. Change a number here, then rerun setup_obs.py and reload the overlay in OBS.
